title: MathQuest lane manifest, version 1
description: What one lane adds to the shared registries. Applied by tests/scripts/ws-integrate.mjs in merge order; every operation is an insertion of whole lines (design/lanes/README.md). There is no field that removes, renames, moves or edits anything.

version.description: The manifest format version. The integrator refuses any other.

lane.description: The lane name; also the key in the ledger (design/lanes/applied.json).

mergeOrder.description: Lanes apply in ascending mergeOrder (ties: lane name). The lead sets it when the lane's branch merges; a later lane gets a larger number.

skills.description: New skills, in the order they are appended. Once applied, this list may only grow at its end (the ledger refuses a removal or a reorder).

providers.description: Provider modules this lane adds; each becomes `import './x.js';` at the end of the import list of js/modules/sheet/providers/index.js. The module file itself is lane code.

lessons.description: Detailed-lesson descriptions this lane adds; each becomes an import line and a DETAILED_LESSONS entry in js/modules/lessons/detailed/index.js. The lesson file itself is lane code.

layout.description: Optional, written by --extract: the exact text of each block, so re-applying reproduces existing files byte for byte. Every entry in a block must be the same data as the skills section (checked). Lanes normally leave this out and the integrator renders one line per entry at the end of the registry.

after.description: The key of the entry the block follows; null = the start of the registry; "$end" = after its last entry. For `skills` it must be the last entry of the category (append only).

text.description: Whole lines, ending in a newline.

entry.description: The SKILLS row (data.js SKILLS[category]), appended at the end of its category: {v, l, ...} with v = the skill id; presetOf for a preset.

code.description: The pinned share code (skill-codes-frozen.js FROZEN_SKILL_CODES). Required: a new skill is pinned the moment it is added. Must not already be pinned; the apply is refused if any existing code or position would move.

printSize.description: data.js SKILL_PRINT_SIZE (legacy print path; still needed by a real new skill, not by a preset).

mixedPoolExclude.description: Mixed pools (their bare skill ids) this skill is kept out of: a NEW data.js MIXED_POOL_EXCLUDE entry per pool. Adding to an existing pool entry is an edit and is refused.

generatorCategory.description: generate-question.js skillCategoryOverride: the generator that deals this skill when it is not its UI category's.

preset.description: skill-presets.js SKILL_PRESETS: the host skill and the option values. The host must be live (or in this manifest).

wrm.description: wrm.js SKILL_WRM: step ids, or {step, partial|note}.

primaryTerms.description: search-terms.js PRIMARY_SKILLS: phrases that must rank this skill first.

concepts.description: search-terms.js CONCEPT_RULES: concepts this skill joins; rendered as one exact-id rule. A rule may never match another lane's or the base's skills.

keys.description: Key form overrides for the bare-keyed registries (grades, timeCategory, printSize, dispatch): the value is the full 'category:skill' key, for a skill id another category also uses.
